standard-dialogue.npc: Ah, a stranger to our island. What brings you here?

standard-dialogue.player: Well, I've actually come here on a diplomatic mission. I want to try and settle some of the disputes between the Fremenniks and your clan.

standard-dialogue.npc: The Rremenniks? Pah! They are just too ignorant and stubborn to listen to anything we have to say - how can we possibly associate with a race that won't listen?

standard-dialogue.player: I think they are very eager to listen, but they feel like you are keeping secrets from them.
Yes, as in your magic ways. To be honest, I think it is fear of the unknown.

standard-dialogue.npc: Well, when the day comes that a Fremennik can prove they have the patience and interest in learning our ways, then we will perhaps share our secrets.

standard-dialogue.player: I'm hoping I might be able to achieve that.

standard-dialogue.npc: Good luck. It's far from simple.

during-lunar-diplomacy.player: I'm on the lookout for ceremonial clothing so I can visit my dreams. I don't suppose you could help me out?

during-lunar-diplomacy.npc: Ah, I know the ceremony very well. Maybe I can help. I do have a cape, but why would I want to give it so some random person off the streets?

during-lunar-diplomacy.player: Because you're a kind person and like helping people in need?

during-lunar-diplomacy.npc: Nice try. But I am always glad to help a person in need, if they can demonstrate some insight.
How about you try and guess my name!

steps.player: Well you do seem to have a moustache growing.

steps.npc: Ah, you'd think so, but no. That is my alias. I want you to tell me my REAL name! I have one first name, and a triple barrel surname!

steps.player: Oh no. Can't you give me some kind of clue?

steps.npc: Ok. Change a letter from the word Dane to get my first name. The first part of my surname rhymes with wood, the third part rhymes with spade and the second rhymes with magic.

steps.player: Woo hoo! Not the most normal name is it?

steps.npc: It's not my fault my parents had an over active imagination.

steps.player: Sounds like they were totally insane.

steps.npc: Do you want this cape or not?
